v18-20.candidate: But the prophet who shall act ungodly, speaking in My name a word which I did not command him to speak, or who shall speak in the name of other gods, that prophet shall die.

v20-14.candidate: save the women and the dependent households. And you shall take as spoil unto yourself all the livestock, and all that is in the city, and all its goods; and you shall eat all the spoil of your enemies which the Lord your God gives you.
